## Introduction
This is a temporary nether world instances creation plugin, that can link each nether portal to different world instances.
The instances are able to be deleted after minutes or to be deleted if no player in that nether world.

## Commands
/new list Show list of instances
/new reload Reload the configuration
/new debug info Get the world name of current location
